name: Gakuto!
source:
Misuzaku School hosts over 100,000 students. As discipline committee goes on rampage, main character suggests a new set of rules, but to enforce them he needs to win school elections. There are a lot of candidates to compete with - like a hentai girl who wants to change school uniform into swimsuits or a martial artist girl who wants to turn school into fighting grounds. But the root of evil is discipline committee chairman who is trying to turn the school into his own harem. To win the elections protagonist must get the buttons that all candidates have. A new school life of love, battle and conspiracy begins!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
御雀学园拥有超过10万名学生。风纪委员会横行霸道，主人公提出一套新规则，但若想真正推行，就必须赢得学生选举。竞争对手众多，例如想把校服改成泳装的变态少女，以及想把学校变成格斗场的武术少女。然而一切邪恶的根源，是企图把学校变成个人后宫的风纪委员会委员长。要赢得选举，主人公必须取得所有候选人持有的纽扣。一段充满爱情、战斗与阴谋的新校园生活就此开始！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
